title: Logistics Operations Manager
description: We’re Hiring: Operations & Logistics Manager (E-commerce)Location: (Remote/Brazil | ⏰ Full-timeWe’re looking for an Operations & Logistics Manager who can keep products moving smoothly—from supplier to customer—without drama. If you love building systems, solving shipping puzzles, and making fulfillment faster + cheaper, you’ll fit right in.What you’ll own You’ll be the glue between supply chain, fulfillment, and customer experience. Key responsibilities include but not limited to:Manage end-to-end logistics: inbound freight, warehousing/3PL, outbound shippingOwn relationships + performance with 3PLs, carriers, freight forwarders, and vendorsImprove shipping speed, accuracy, and cost (aka: fewer “where is my package?” moments)Oversee inventory flow and replenishment planning to prevent stockouts/overstockCreate and maintain SOPs for receiving, picking/packing, returns, and exception handlingBuild dashboards for key KPIs (OTIF, shipping cost/order, fulfillment accuracy, returns rate)Lead continuous improvement projects (process, tools, automation, packaging optimization)Coordinate cross-functionally with CX, marketing, finance, and product team on launches and promosWhat success looks like (90 days) ✅ 3PL/carrier performance clearly tracked and improved✅ Fewer shipping issues + faster resolution time✅ Clear SOPs + smoother handoffs between teams✅ Inventory is more predictable (less “oops we ran out”)✅ Shipping costs are controlled while service levels stay strongWhat we’re looking for 3+ years in logistics/operations (bonus: DTC e-commerce, Shopify, Amazon, or retail)Strong vendor management skills (you can hold partners accountable politely but firmly)Solid understanding of shipping + freight (domestic and/or international)Comfortable with data + spreadsheets (you can measure stuff, not just “feel” stuff)Organized, proactive, and calm when things go sideways (because… they will)Process builder: you document, improve, and automate—not just “do the work”Tools you may use (nice to have) Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite/QuickBooks, ShipStation/ShipBob, 3PL portals, Asana/ClickUp, Airtable, Google Sheets/Excel, Zapier/MakeWhy join us We’re growing fast and need someone who can help us scale without breaking fulfillment. You’ll have real ownership, a direct impact on profitability + customer experience, and a team that moves quickly.How to applySend your resume + a short note answering:What’s one logistics or fulfillment process you improved, and what changed?What systems/3PLs/carriers have you worked with?

title: Pessoa Analista De Suporte N1
description: A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. O DESAFIO : Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte Nível 1 para atuar no atendimento inicial de chamados relacionados ao produto Garantias da plataforma Dimensa. Este profissional será responsável por organizar e realizar a triagem inicial dos chamados de clientes, garantindo o correto registro das informações, entendimento inicial da demanda e direcionamento para os times internos responsáveis pela análise técnica e de negócio. Não é necessário conhecimento prévio do produto, porém buscamos um perfil organizado, com boa comunicação e experiência no uso de ferramentas de suporte. Realizar o primeiro atendimento (N1) aos chamados de clientes relacionados ao produto Garantias. Registrar, classificar e organizar chamados na ferramenta de suporte. Garantir que os chamados possuam informações completas e estruturadas antes do direcionamento ao time técnico. Fazer o encaminhamento das demandas para as áreas internas responsáveis pela tratativa. Elaborar atualizações e status semanais dos chamados, contribuindo para o acompanhamento das demandas com ponto focal do cliente. Participar de reuniões internas de alinhamento com o time. Apoiar na organização e melhoria da documentação dos chamados. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA: Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente, service desk ou atendimento de chamados (mínimo 6 meses) Desejável experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados, como Zendesk ou similares. Boa comunicação escrita e verbal. Capacidade de organização e registro detalhado de informações. Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas internas. DIFERENCIAL: Experiência em triagem ou gestão de chamados de suporte. Experiência em ambientes de tecnologia ou software de produtos financeiros. Vivência com acompanhamento e controle de demandas em ferramentas de suporte. Desejável: Formação em TI ou ADM Conhecimentos básicos de SQL/ consultas a banco de dados. Chamada de serviços (webservices) Experiência administrativa em gestão de chamados e ou/ atendimento ao suporte N1. Sistema: Gestão de Garantias, Java, banco de dados Oracle. O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica

title: Go High Level (Ghl) Intern

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented GoHighLevel (GHL) Marketing Intern to support the growth of our vacation rental management business. This role is ideal for someone who wants hands-on experience in funnel building, landing pages, and performance marketing. The program is a 3-month remote internship, during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program. Check with your school's Internship Coordinator BEFORE accepting the hiring offer to determine if this position satisfies the criteria for receiving academic credit. What’s In It For You? It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule. You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver. Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace. 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week. Issued certification upon successfully completing the program. Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance. Key Responsibilities: Update and optimize our existing GoHighLevel website for a vacation rental management company Collaborate with the business owner and marketing coach to implement pre-planned funnel pages and campaigns Build and maintain high-converting landing pages for vacation rental properties (with scalable/duplicable templates) Ensure all pages are fully functional, user-friendly, and properly tracking traffic sources (especially Facebook Ads) Support customer acquisition efforts by coordinating email marketing and Facebook ad campaigns already in place Monitor and optimize campaign performance to improve guest conversion and increase direct bookings Implement additional marketing strategies on the website (e.G., blog pages, service pages) Provide recommendations to improve website traffic, lead generation, and conversion rates Ensure consistent website experience across all traffic sources, including referrals from partner platforms (e.G., tourist bureau listings) Qualifications: Basic experience or strong interest in GoHighLevel (GHL) Familiarity with landing pages, funnels, and digital marketing concepts Understanding of Facebook Ads and email marketing (hands-on experience is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot page issues Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively Self-starter with a willingness to learn and take initiative Nice to Have: Experience in vacation rental, hospitality, or real estate marketing Basic knowledge of SEO and content marketing (blogs, service pages) Experience with analytics and tracking tools About us: Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team. What We Value: Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough Discipline - Be consistent in your actions Ambition - Aspire to become better every day Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Professor De Inglês Empresarial
description: Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00.QualificaçõesEnsino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência.Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações.Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos.Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo.Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo.Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

title: Especialista Em Plant Simulation (Pj)
description: Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Você será a ponte entre a engenharia industrial e a tomada de decisão estratégica, testando cenários virtuais para otimizar o fluxo de produção, reduzir gargalos e validar novos investimentos antes que eles saiam do papel. Principais Responsabilidades Modelagem e Simulação: Desenvolver modelos dinâmicos de alta complexidade utilizando o software Tecnomatix Plant Simulation. Análise de Gargalos e Otimização: Analisar fluxos de materiais, capacidade de armazenamento, utilização de recursos (máquinas e operadores) e logística interna. Programação SimTalk: Criar lógicas personalizadas e métodos avançados de controle utilizando a linguagem de programação nativa do software (SimTalk 2.0). Validação de Cenários (What-if): Propor e testar alterações de layout, mix de produtos e novas tecnologias (como AGVs/AMRs) reportando o ROI das mudanças. Integração de Dados: Conectar os modelos de simulação com bancos de dados (SQL, Oracle), planilhas e outros sistemas corporativos (ERP, MES, PLM). Apresentação de Resultados: Traduzir dados técnicos de simulação em relatórios claros e dashboards para a diretoria e gerentes de planta. Requisitos e Qualificações O que você precisa ter (Essencial): Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Controle e Automação) ou Ciência da Computação / áreas correlatas. Sólida experiência prática com o Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation. Domínio de programação em SimTalk. Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída). Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos). O que vai te destacar (Diferencial): Conhecimento em outras ferramentas Siemens (Process Simulate, NX MCD, Teamcenter). Experiência com linguagens de programação adicionais (Python, C++, SQL). Experiência com emulação (comissionamento virtual conectando o modelo a PLCs reais). Contratação: PJ.

title: Data & Ai Tech Lead
description:
Job Description A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Duties and Responsibilities: - Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.
- Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.
- Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.
- Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.
- Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa. Minimum Qualifications/Experience: - Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.
- Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.
- Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.
- Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.
- Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.
- Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos. Minimum Education: Ensino superior completo. Inglês Fluente

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us: Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach. The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively. Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market;
proactive outreach tools;
share & peer holder tracking;
customisable reports;
and professional-level support. Role Overview: We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team. You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows. You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.Com. Responsibilities: Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform. Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams. Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction. Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy. Qualifications: Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals. Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders. Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions. Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors. Fluent in English and Spanish Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team. Shape the future of investor relations technology. Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients. Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture. If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you. This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Ai Art Director (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description: So... what the hell is Ark Exotic?Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native art direct who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.What You'll Do- Lead a team of designers to create visuals that stop scrolls- Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads- Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)- Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders- Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars- Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demandsWho You Are- We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.- You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before- You've mastered Freepik Spaces and Higgsfield- You understand the difference between /"looks expensive/" and /"feels exclusive/"- Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel- You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world- You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure- Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.- You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster /"Hunt/" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brandWhat We're Building- The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.- This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.What We're Offering- Competitive salary based on your portfolio- 10 days PTO per year- Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale- Fully remoteHow to Apply- A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language- A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaignIf the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

Originação, estruturação e fechamento de operações de crédito corporativo ;

Gestão e acompanhamento do pipeline comercial (Funil de Vendas, CRM, Forecast) ;
Condução de negociações comerciais complexas, alinhando risco, retorno e estratégia;
Interface constan tecom áreas internas como Crédito, Risco, Produtos, Jurídico, Backoffice e Compliance;
Contribuição ativa na definição da estratégia, modelo comercial e posicionamento do segmento Upper Middle ou Corporate. Monitoramento de mercado, concorrência e oportunidades em Corporate Banking ou Middle Market Finance. Principais requisitos: Certificação CPA‑20 ativa (obrigatória) ;
Vivência como: Banker Upper Middle Corporate Banker Relationship Manager Corporate / Middle Market Gerente de Relacionamento Empresas / Corporate Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito bancário, como: Capital de Giro Crédito estruturado Operações Bilaterais e Sindicadas Produtos de Atacado / Corporate Finance Histórico comprovado em originação de novos negócios (Hunter) ;
Forte perfil comercial consultivo, relacional e negociador, com acesso a decisores (C‑level, CFO, empresários);
Capacidade de navegarem ambientes regulados e com governança robusta. Diferenciais: Atuação anterior em Corporate Banking, Middle Market ou Atacado ;
Experiência em expansão ou construção de carteiras/squads comerciais ;
Vivência em bancos, instituições financeiras ou plataformas de crédito corporativo;
Visão estratégica combinada com execução comercial intensa.

title: Pessoa Analista De Suporte N1
description: A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência. O DESAFIO : Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte Nível 1 para atuar no atendimento inicial de chamados relacionados ao produto Garantias da plataforma Dimensa. Este profissional será responsável por organizar e realizar a triagem inicial dos chamados de clientes, garantindo o correto registro das informações, entendimento inicial da demanda e direcionamento para os times internos responsáveis pela análise técnica e de negócio. Não é necessário conhecimento prévio do produto, porém buscamos um perfil organizado, com boa comunicação e experiência no uso de ferramentas de suporte. Realizar o primeiro atendimento (N1) aos chamados de clientes relacionados ao produto Garantias. Registrar, classificar e organizar chamados na ferramenta de suporte. Garantir que os chamados possuam informações completas e estruturadas antes do direcionamento ao time técnico. Fazer o encaminhamento das demandas para as áreas internas responsáveis pela tratativa. Elaborar atualizações e status semanais dos chamados, contribuindo para o acompanhamento das demandas com ponto focal do cliente. Participar de reuniões internas de alinhamento com o time. Apoiar na organização e melhoria da documentação dos chamados. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA: Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente, service desk ou atendimento de chamados (mínimo 6 meses) Desejável experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados, como Zendesk ou similares. Boa comunicação escrita e verbal. Capacidade de organização e registro detalhado de informações. Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas internas. DIFERENCIAL: Experiência em triagem ou gestão de chamados de suporte. Experiência em ambientes de tecnologia ou software de produtos financeiros. Vivência com acompanhamento e controle de demandas em ferramentas de suporte. Desejável: Formação em TI ou ADM Conhecimentos básicos de SQL/ consultas a banco de dados. Chamada de serviços (webservices) Experiência administrativa em gestão de chamados e ou/ atendimento ao suporte N1. Sistema: Gestão de Garantias, Java, banco de dados Oracle. O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica

description: Buscamos um Especialista em Plant Simulation para liderar a criação de gêmeos digitais (Digital Twins) e modelos de simulação de eventos discretos. Conhecimento forte em Estatística aplicada à simulação (distribuições de probabilidade, validação de dados de entrada e análise de saída). Visão de Processos Industriais (Lean Manufacturing, tempos e métodos, gargalos). You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement. Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ai Trainer
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency About Prolific Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world. Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills. The role We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models. Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter. What you’ll bring Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese. Fluency in English (B2+) A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients What you’ll be doing in the role Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts Improving cutting-edge AI models Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home. We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity. Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities. title: Account Manager
description:
About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement. Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Sales Ai Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder Role Overview: You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows;
you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Key Responsibilities: - Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
- Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.
- Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.
- CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention. Qualifications: - Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.
- AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.G., 11x, Regie.Ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.
- Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Consultor Sap Abap Fi-Ca/Rmca (Pj)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país. Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme. E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente? Responsabilidades e atribuições Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP. Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia: Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento. Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema: Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes. Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria: Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time. Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP. title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Administrador De Sistemas Linux
description: Cargo: Linux Server Manager Local de atuação: Remoto Horário de Trabalho: Horário Comercial Idioma: Inglês Fluente Contrato : 1 ano, podendo prorrogar. Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project) Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem. Você fará parte de um projeto global, integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais. Principais Responsabilidades Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema: Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents ), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho. Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração. Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes. Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede. Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos. Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua. Requisitos Técnicos Centrais Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema. Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis. Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP. Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial. Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade. Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF. Qualificações e Experiência Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores. Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas. Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês. Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

title: Cx Ai & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil)
description: About us Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI, review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information. You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work. Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement What success looks like in the first 90 days Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions Launch a simple QA process for AI responses Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes Make it easier for team members to find the right answer fast What we’re looking for 3+ years in customer experience, CX operations, knowledge management, support enablement, or a similar role Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or another support platform Strong writing and editing skills Experience building or maintaining a help center, FAQ library, or internal knowledge base Comfortable reviewing support conversations and turning patterns into process improvements Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information into clear guidance Able to train people, not just tools Bonus points Experience in e-commerce, especially Shopify brands Experience with AI support tools, automation, and QA workflows Experience writing SOPs, training materials, or internal playbooks Familiarity with product catalogs, product information, or merchandising workflows Why this role matters This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful. How to apply Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions: Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved. Tell us about a time you trained or improved an AI or automation workflow. How would you keep product information accurate across multiple teams?

title: Devops Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions. Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks. Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents. Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions. Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation. Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks. Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.
